plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single-name mandate.
Add to QQQI, increasing its allocation to 25%, favoring income and quality names.
Buy OXY for 10% of the book, diversifying with a strong scanner setup.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and reduces overall portfolio risk.
conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for a modest ~1.5%/month return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and diversifying holdings. Expect lower volatility but also limited upside potential.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure while maintaining a small allocation.
Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and meet the single-name mandate.
Buy OXY for 4% of the book, diversifying with a strong scanner setup.
Buy CRM for 4% of the book, adding quality tech exposure.
This plan balances risk and growth, maintaining some leverage and diversifying into new quality names.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5%/month, aiming for risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while introducing new quality names. Expect moderate volatility and a balanced approach to market exposure.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet the single-name concentration mandate.
Add to SOXL, increasing its allocation to 6%, and add to SPAL, increasing its allocation to 6%, leaning into leveraged ETFs.
Buy OXY for 8% of the book, leveraging a strong scanner setup.
Buy CRM for 8% of the book, focusing on a strong tech scanner setup.
This plan uses leverage and concentrates in high-scoring setups for aggressive growth.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month, aiming for stretched growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware this approach carries substantially higher risk, including larger drawdowns and the daily decay of leveraged ETFs. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single-name mandate.
Add to QQQI, increasing its allocation to 30%, prioritizing income and monthly distributions.
Trim QQQ to 10% to reduce growth exposure and shift towards income.
This plan focuses on generating steady monthly distributions with lower drawdown.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1%/month, aiming to park cash for yield. It prioritizes income-generating ETFs and broad index exposure, cutting high-beta names. While aiming for steady distributions, remember these are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff. This is not a savings account.
